rule: Whitespace runs first replaced with one space and preserved in ordered ledger. Only repeated balanced parentheses with identical non-whitespace tokens are shared. Expand dictionary tokens in reverse numeric order, remove the encoded display final LF, then replace the ith canonical space by the ith ledger entry. Exact original UTF8 bytes reconstructed. This is lexical-token coverage, not literal repeated raw-byte rereading.
whitespaceLedgerEncoding: Ordered unique whitespace-run dictionary plus zero-based integer sequence; reconstruct each run with dictionary[sequence[i]].
